# AdEasy

> AdEasy provides marketing leadership for growing home-service brands: an outsourced CMO with a team of builders behind it. We lead the marketing plan, oversee vendors and campaigns, add execution where it's needed and build the missing infrastructure, so owners get more qualified customers with less marketing to manage. Based in Winnipeg, founded in 2013 by Chris Karasewich.

AdEasy works with plumbing and drain, HVAC and mechanical, electrical, and window and door companies across Canada and the U.S. Most partners are owner-led businesses that have outgrown doing marketing themselves. Every engagement starts with one of three leadership levels (Advisory, Managed or Executive), with optional execution add-ons (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Local SEO & GBP, reviews, past-customer marketing, commercial proof, AI visibility) and one-time infrastructure projects (tracking, websites, brand and proof assets, AI assistants). Every engagement follows three phases: Create a Plan (a kickoff, account access, a review of the last 12 months of data and a 12-month roadmap with budget recommendations, covered by the leadership fee), Build the Foundation (scoped infrastructure projects) and Grow the Shop (running the plan, with monthly reviews). Every client gets a monthly in-person review of their Marketing Dashboard, budget advice, a quarterly infrastructure review, project updates, monitoring that flags broken forms, tracking and campaigns, and a plain-English read on vendor reports. New partners start with a free Marketing Systems Assessment: we research the business, review eight marketing systems with the owner, and send a three-page report showing what's working, what needs attention and what to fix first.

Contact: 204-809-4978 · support@adeasy.com · 309 McDermot Ave, Unit 230, Winnipeg, MB R3A 1T3
